versions.name: Patch 1.4.4 (Classic / Pre-Reforged)
versions.description: The legacy pre-Reforged era featuring +15 gear upgrading, Mastery progression, original cell categories (Power, Technique, Defence, Mobility, Utility), and no Power Surging or Omnicells.

versions.name: Patch 1.6.2 (Early Reforged)
versions.description: Early Reforged era with original cell socket types (Power, Technique, Defence, Mobility, Utility), Aetherheart Power Surging, and no Omnicells.

versions.name: Patch 1.12.0 (Reforged Mid-Era)
versions.description: Mid-Reforged update introducing the revised cell socket categories (Brutality, Finesse, Fortitude, Alacrity, Insight) and Omnicells.

versions.name: Patch 1.14.7 (Reforged Final)
versions.description: The peak Reforged meta with full Behemoth rosters (Frostwülf, Phaelanx, Fenroar), all 6 Omnicells, and expanded cell perks.

versions.name: Patch 2.1.1 (Awakening)
versions.description: The Awakening overhaul featuring Weapon Talents, Lantern Cores, and revised equipment progression.
